name: Mohéli (Comoros, 1997–1998)
description: A vertical bicolour of yellow at the hoist and red at the fly.
history: Hoisted by the separatists at Fomboni who declared the Democratic Republic of Mohéli on 11 August 1997, reviving the nineteenth-century flag of Sultan Jumbe Fatima. The secession collapsed in 1998; the island's present flag dates from the 2001 federal constitution.
